tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 42 (out_of_hours bounds correction). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - measured live: a request with from='today' and after='03:00 PM' during the afternoon returned real slots from 03:30 pm onward BUT flagged out_of_hours=true with requested_clock '03:00 PM'. Root cause: the lane-41 bounds logic derives operating hours from the searched window's returned slots - when the window is a partial day whose earliest remaining slot is 03:30 pm, a 3:00 pm request reads as before-opening. The flag then routes the pathway to its miss branch even though good offers exist. BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-41. Produce ./fixed-bland_gateway.py with a minimal in-style diff. THE FIX: (1) out_of_hours must be computed against bounds that are NOT narrowed by the request's own after/before/anchor filtering or by same-day slot consumption: derive the clock bounds from the UNFILTERED slot clocks across the full searched window (all days, before applying the after/before clock filter); if the implementation cannot access prefiltered slots cheaply, widen using min/max slot clocks observed across every day of the window. (2) Regardless of bounds, if the filtered result contains one or more real slots whose clock is at or after (for 'after') / at or before (for 'before') / within the day for an anchor of the requested clock, out_of_hours MUST be false - a request that real inventory can satisfy is never out of hours. (3) Genuinely out-of-hours clocks (3am) keep flagging true exactly as lane-41 proved. (4) Tests beside the existing suite using the frozen-today pattern: partial-day case (window=single day whose remaining slots start 03:30 pm; after='03:00 PM' -> out_of_hours false, slots returned), uppercase '03:00 PM' parses identically to '3:00 pm', full-window regression, 3am case still true. Build ./gwtest as a copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39b/gw-datetime-tolerance/gw with fixed-bland_gateway.py installed; full suite green. (5) ./proof_bounds.py: standalone, imports from ./gwtest, no network; must print 'CASE=partial-day-3pm OUT_OF_HOURS=false' and 'CASE=3am OUT_OF_HOURS=true' by exercising the bounds/decision function offline with synthetic slot data; print 'CASE=<name> OFFLINE=untestable' only if truly impossible and justify in DEBUG-GW42.md. (6) DEBUG-GW42.md: the live evidence, the code location, the change, test output tails, deploy separately gated.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_bounds.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; grep -q 'CASE=partial-day-3pm OUT_OF_HOURS=false' proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: partial-day case'; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; grep -q 'CASE=3am OUT_OF_HOURS=true' proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: 3am regression'; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; diffcount=$(python3 -c "import difflib;a=open('deployed-bland_gateway.py').readlines();b=open('fixed-bland_gateway.py').readlines();print(sum(1 for l in difflib.unified_diff(a,b) if l.startswith(('+','-')) and not l.startswith(('+++','---'))))"); [ "$diffcount" -lt 160 ] || { echo "FAIL: diff too large ($diffcount)"; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: bounds corrected - $summary"
tasks.verified: out_of_hours derives from unfiltered window bounds and can never flag a request that real inventory satisfies, with the genuine 3am case still flagged - proven by executing the decision logic and the full suite against a minimal diff on the byte-true deployed lane-41 file.
